scope: overtaking (passing another vehicle, and being passed)

vocabulary.definition: Changing lanes to move past a slower vehicle, then returning to the original lane.

Designated areas that allow pedestrians to safely cross roads where there are no traffic lights, identified by specific signs, overhead yellow lights, and pavement markings consisting of two white double parallel lines across the road with an X in each lane approaching it.
Large vehicles such as tractor-trailers and buses.

rules.title: General safety for passing
rules.when: the PASSER is unsure they can PASS without danger to themselves or others
rules.action: overtake and pass another vehicle
rules.statement: WHEN the PASSER is unsure they can PASS without danger to themselves or others, the PASSER MUST NOT overtake and pass another vehicle.

rules.title: No passing moving snow plows
rules.when: a SNOW PLOW is moving
rules.action: pass the SNOW PLOW
rules.statement: WHEN a SNOW PLOW is moving, the PASSER MUST NOT pass the SNOW PLOW.

rules.title: Passing procedure: signal and check
rules.when: the PASSER intends to PASS
rules.action: use the left-turn signal AND check that the way is clear ahead and behind before moving into the passing lane
rules.statement: WHEN the PASSER intends to PASS, the PASSER MUST use the left-turn signal AND check that the way is clear ahead and behind before moving into the passing lane.

rules.title: Passing procedure: watch for hazards
rules.when: the PASSER is PASSING
rules.action: watch for bicycles and small vehicles that may be hidden from view in front of the vehicle being passed AND watch for vehicles that may be turning left in front AND vehicles or pedestrians entering the road from another road or driveway
rules.statement: WHEN the PASSER is PASSING, the PASSER SHOULD watch for bicycles and small vehicles that may be hidden from view in front of the vehicle being passed AND watch for vehicles that may be turning left in front AND vehicles or pedestrians entering the road from another road or driveway.

rules.title: Passing procedure: signal return
rules.when: the PASSER intends to move back into the original lane after overtaking
rules.action: signal the intention to move back
rules.statement: WHEN the PASSER intends to move back into the original lane after overtaking, the PASSER MUST signal the intention to move back.

rules.title: Passing procedure: return timing
rules.when: the PASSER can see the entire front of the passed vehicle in the inside mirror
rules.action: make the lane change back into the original lane
rules.statement: WHEN the PASSER can see the entire front of the passed vehicle in the inside mirror, the PASSER MAY make the lane change back into the original lane.

rules.title: Passing procedure: avoid cutting off
rules.when: returning to the original lane after a PASS
rules.action: cut off the passed vehicle by suddenly moving in front of it
rules.statement: WHEN returning to the original lane after a PASS, the PASSER MUST NOT cut off the passed vehicle by suddenly moving in front of it.

rules.title: Passing procedure: handled passed vehicle speeding up
rules.when: the vehicle being passed speeds up during a PASS
rules.action: race AND must return to the original lane
rules.statement: WHEN the vehicle being passed speeds up during a PASS, the PASSER MUST NOT race AND must return to the original lane.

rules.title: No passing near a pedestrian crossover
rules.when: within 30 metres of a PEDESTRIAN CROSSOVER
rules.action: pass any vehicle
rules.statement: WHEN within 30 metres of a PEDESTRIAN CROSSOVER, the PASSER MUST NOT pass any vehicle.
rules.note: Rule stated on two different pages.

rules.title: No passing left of centerline near structures
rules.when: within 30 metres of a bridge, viaduct or tunnel
rules.action: pass left of a centreline
rules.statement: WHEN within 30 metres of a bridge, viaduct or tunnel, the PASSER MUST NOT pass left of a centreline.

rules.title: No passing on hills or curves
rules.when: approaching the crest of a hill OR on a curve where vision of oncoming traffic is obstructed AND there is not enough clear distance ahead to pass in safety
rules.action: attempt to PASS
rules.statement: WHEN approaching the crest of a hill OR on a curve where vision of oncoming traffic is obstructed AND there is not enough clear distance ahead to pass in safety, the PASSER MUST NOT attempt to PASS.

vague_terms.term: enough clear distance ahead to pass in safety

rules.title: Passing parked vehicles
rules.when: PASSING parked vehicles
rules.action: watch carefully for people suddenly opening doors or for doors opened to load and unload
rules.statement: WHEN PASSING parked vehicles, the DRIVER SHOULD watch carefully for people suddenly opening doors or for doors opened to load and unload.

rules.title: Passing motorcycles, bicycles, and mopeds in lane
rules.when: motorcycles, bicycles, limited-speed motorcycles or mopeds pull to the left or right side of their lane to avoid dangerous road conditions or to be seen by other drivers
rules.action: pass in the same lane AND must change lanes to PASS
rules.statement: WHEN motorcycles, bicycles, limited-speed motorcycles or mopeds pull to the left or right side of their lane to avoid dangerous road conditions or to be seen by other drivers, the PASSER MUST NOT pass in the same lane AND must change lanes to PASS.

rules.title: Passing cyclists distance
rules.when: PASSING a CYCLIST
rules.action: maintain a minimum distance of one metre, where practical between the vehicle and the CYCLIST
rules.statement: WHEN PASSING a CYCLIST, the DRIVER of a motor vehicle MUST maintain a minimum distance of one metre, where practical between the vehicle and the CYCLIST.
rules.penalty: A fine and an additional two demerit points.

vague_terms.explanation: does not define conditions under which one metre is impractical

rules.title: Passing cyclists lane change
rules.when: PASSING a CYCLIST
rules.action: change lanes to pass whenever possible
rules.statement: WHEN PASSING a CYCLIST, the DRIVER SHOULD change lanes to pass whenever possible.

rules.title: Passing large commercial vehicles distance
rules.when: PASSING a LARGE COMMERCIAL VEHICLE
rules.action: cut in front closely AND should allow more room
rules.statement: WHEN PASSING a LARGE COMMERCIAL VEHICLE, the PASSER MUST NOT cut in front closely AND should allow more room.

rules.title: Passing large vehicles: wide right turns
rules.when: a LARGE COMMERCIAL VEHICLE in front is making a right turn
rules.action: move up into the space that opens up in the right lane
rules.statement: WHEN a LARGE COMMERCIAL VEHICLE in front is making a right turn, the DRIVER MUST NOT move up into the space that opens up in the right lane.

rules.title: Passing large vehicles: wide left turns
rules.when: a LARGE COMMERCIAL VEHICLE is making a left turn in front
rules.action: drive up into the left lane
rules.statement: WHEN a LARGE COMMERCIAL VEHICLE is making a left turn in front, the DRIVER MUST NOT drive up into the left lane.

rules.title: Passing streetcars: side
rules.when: PASSING streetcars
rules.action: pass on the right
rules.unless: the DRIVER is driving on a one-way road
rules.statement: WHEN PASSING streetcars, the PASSER MUST pass on the right, UNLESS the DRIVER is driving on a one-way road.

rules.title: Passing streetcars: distance at stops
rules.when: at streetcar stops
rules.action: stay at least two metres behind the rear doors where passengers are getting off or on
rules.unless: an area has been set aside for streetcar passengers
rules.statement: WHEN at streetcar stops, the DRIVER MUST stay at least two metres behind the rear doors where passengers are getting off or on, UNLESS an area has been set aside for streetcar passengers.

rules.title: Night passing: low beams
rules.when: approaching a vehicle from behind at night
rules.action: switch headlights to low beams
rules.statement: WHEN approaching a vehicle from behind at night, the DRIVER MUST switch headlights to low beams.
rules.note: Consistent with light rules on page 14.

rules.title: Night passing: procedure
rules.when: the PASSER intends to PASS at night
rules.action: signal, check mirrors and blind spot, and pull out to pass
rules.statement: WHEN the PASSER intends to PASS at night, the PASSER MUST signal, check mirrors and blind spot, and pull out to pass.

rules.title: Night passing: high beams
rules.when: the PASSER is moving alongside the vehicle being passed at night
rules.action: switch on high beams
rules.statement: WHEN the PASSER is moving alongside the vehicle being passed at night, the PASSER SHOULD switch on high beams.

rules.title: Night passing: return
rules.when: the PASSER can see all of the front of the passed vehicle in the rear view mirror at night
rules.action: pull back into the right lane
rules.statement: WHEN the PASSER can see all of the front of the passed vehicle in the rear view mirror at night, the PASSER MAY pull back into the right lane.
rules.note: The handbook also specifies that the PASSER must remember to signal.

rules.title: Passing on right shoulder
rules.when: passing a vehicle turning left
rules.action: drive on the right shoulder
rules.statement: WHEN passing a vehicle turning left, the DRIVER MAY drive on the right shoulder, UNLESS the shoulder is not paved.

rules.title: No passing on left shoulder
rules.when: performing a PASS
rules.action: pass on the left shoulder
rules.statement: WHEN performing a PASS, the PASSER MUST NOT pass on the left shoulder.
rules.note: The handbook clarifies this applies whether the shoulder is paved or not.

rules.title: Passing on the right: general
rules.when: on multi-lane roads OR one-way roads OR overtaking a streetcar OR overtaking a left-turning vehicle
rules.action: pass on the right
rules.statement: WHEN on multi-lane roads OR one-way roads OR overtaking a streetcar OR overtaking a left-turning vehicle, the PASSER MAY pass on the right.

rules.title: Passing on the right: caution
rules.when: a slower vehicle is in front in the leftmost lane
rules.action: suddenly change lanes and pass on the right
rules.statement: WHEN a slower vehicle is in front in the leftmost lane, the PASSER SHOULD NOT suddenly change lanes and pass on the right.

rules.title: Being passed: general
rules.when: faster traffic wants to PASS
rules.action: move to the right and let them pass in safety
rules.statement: WHEN faster traffic wants to PASS, the DRIVER SHOULD move to the right and let them pass in safety.

rules.title: Being passed: undivided road
rules.when: being passed on an undivided road where the PASSER has pulled into the opposite lane
rules.action: move closer to the right side of the lane AND be prepared to slow down
rules.statement: WHEN being passed on an undivided road where the PASSER has pulled into the opposite lane, the DRIVER SHOULD move closer to the right side of the lane AND be prepared to slow down.
